builtin_profile.name: Chat Default（适用于第三方仅提供chat api的模型）

function.request_user_input.guidance: Use this only for real user preferences or decisions that materially change the plan. Do not use it to ask whether to approve, proceed with, or implement a proposed plan; after emitting the final <proposed_plan> block, let the Codex UI handle approval and implementation. Keep option labels short natural phrases without A:/B:/C: prefixes.

function.create_goal.guidance: Call this when the user explicitly asks to mark a goal complete or blocked but get_goal returns no active goal, or update_goal reports that the thread has no goal. Do not set token_budget unless the user explicitly provided a numeric token budget.

function.update_goal.guidance: Before updating a goal, use get_goal when goal state is uncertain. If no active goal exists or this tool reports that the thread has no goal, call create_goal first with a concise objective and no token_budget unless explicitly requested, then retry update_goal with the requested status.

function.exec_command.interactive_guidance: When an interactive command returns a session_id, reuse that exact session_id instead of starting the command again. Use write_stdin for polling, raw character input, or complex multi-step interaction. Boolean parameters such as tty must be JSON booleans true or false, not quoted strings.

custom.exec.guidance: Pass raw JavaScript source in the input string. Do not serialize an exec call object or include input, yield_time_ms, or max_output_tokens as JavaScript object properties. Configure yielding only with the // @exec pragma. For nested tools, await tools.<name>(...) and call text(...), image(...), or audio(...) with the result when the user or task needs to inspect it. A Script completed result is final; call wait only when exec explicitly returns Script running with cell ID.

namespace.multi_agent_v2.list_agents.guidance: path_prefix filters canonical task paths. Use the requested child task-name segment, and treat the returned status and result for that canonical path as authoritative.

namespace.multi_agent_v2.send_message.guidance: target must be the canonical task path returned by spawn_agent. Send the requested message exactly; this delivers to the existing child and does not start a replacement task.

namespace.multi_agent_v2.spawn_agent.guidance: The message field is the complete child task. With fork_turns="none", the child receives no surrounding user turns, so include every instruction the child must follow in message and do not expect it to reconstruct the task from workspace files.

namespace.multi_agent_v2.wait_agent.guidance: This waits for a future mailbox update; it does not replay a completion notification already delivered in the current input. If that completion is already visible, treat it as authoritative instead of repeatedly waiting by reflex.

preset_profiles.name: web.run 注入（适用于尚未支持/alpha/search端点的中转站）
工具映射（适用于第三方模型提供的Responses接口）

description_variants.append: Use send_line for simple single-line input; it appends exactly one newline.
For line-oriented input, use send_line instead of write_stdin.

delivery.deferred_guidance_marker: Some deferred nested tools may be omitted from this description.

replace_text.from: Use raw exec and ALL_TOOLS to read the exact declaration before invoking a match.
replace_text.to: Call tool_read with an exact returned name before invoking a match. Search results alone do not authorize invoke_deferred_tool.

function.name: tool_search
function.description: Search deferred tools in Codex's live ALL_TOOLS runtime catalog. Use natural_language for capability searches and regex for exact name or declaration patterns. Results contain exact names and bounded summaries, not complete declarations, and never become independent Chat functions. Use raw exec and ALL_TOOLS to read the exact declaration before invoking a match.

query.description: Capability, provider, tool name, or declaration text to find. Regex patterns are limited to 200 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tools to return.

search_mode.description: Natural-language token ranking or case-insensitive JavaScript regular-expression matching.

replace_text.from: (and optionally with a domain or recency filter)

function.name: Read
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. Use offset and limit for large files.

function.name: Edit
function.description: Edit an existing file. For file changes, you must use Edit rather than Shell or Python. Replace exact text in a file. old_string must match the raw file text exactly. Prefer replacing complete lines or complete consecutive line blocks, including indentation and unchanged surrounding text within those lines, rather than substrings.

function.name: Write
function.description: Create or overwrite a file. For file creation or replacement, you must use Write rather than Shell or Python. The content must be complete UTF-8 text.

function.name: send_line
function.description: Send one complete line to an existing interactive command session. Use this instead of write_stdin when submitting line-oriented input; the gateway appends exactly one newline.

replace_text.from: Invoke declarations through raw exec as tools.<name>(...).
replace_text.to: Declarations carrying invoke_deferred_tool instructions must be invoked with that dispatcher. Invoke all other declarations through raw exec as tools.<name>(...).

function.name: tool_read
function.description: Read the complete declaration for one deferred tool by exact name from Codex's live ALL_TOOLS runtime catalog. Search results are only summaries; read a declaration before invoking it. Invoke declarations through raw exec as tools.<name>(...).

name.description: Exact tool name returned by tool_search.

function.name: invoke_deferred_tool
function.description: Invoke a deferred tool whose complete declaration and definition_hash were returned by a paired tool_read call in this conversation.

definition_hash.description: Exact definition_hash returned by the paired tool_read result.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool declaration returned by tool_read.
